newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in lacklustre trade, dealers said on Monday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. It's been very quiet today due partly to the lack of fresh factors and partly due to the Memorial Day Holiday in the US, which has left the market short of players," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting Tuesday's release of the (U.S. May) consumer confidence index and (April) existing homes figures, for more clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.

Among term rates, one-month was unchanged from last Friday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months eased 1/8 percentage point to 5-13/16 5-11/16 and twelve-months was unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent.
